name: Ann Walker

bio.statement: Ballotpedia lists Ann Walker, a Republican, as a candidate for Oregon House District 49 in 2026.
bio.excerpt: Ann Walker (Republican Party) is running for election to the Oregon House of Representatives to represent District 49.

bio.statement: Her pamphlet statement lists Walker's occupation as owner of Ann Walker Consulting, LLC and wildfire consultant for 14 years, with a background including Western Governors' Association fire and forestry policy director for 8 years.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Small Business Owner, Ann Walker Consulting, LLC, Wildfire Consultant 14 years Occupational Background: Western Governors' Assn(WGA), Fire and Forestry Policy Director 8 years

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 56

bio.statement: Her pamphlet statement lists federal and state wildland fire and incident management training, forest law courses and Molalla Union High School as her educational background.
bio.excerpt: FEMA Cert 700 National Incident Management; ODF S-110 Wildland Fire Suppression; S-130 Firefighter Training; S-190 Fire Behavior; S-290 Intermediate Wildland Fire Behavior; D-510 Supervisory Dispatcher; Forest Law I & II

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 56

bio.statement: Her pamphlet statement lists WGA Forest Health Advisory Committee lead and Oregon Governor's representative to that committee as prior governmental experience.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: WGA Forest Health Advisory Committee Lead; OR Governor's representative (Kulongoski & Kitzhaber(2) Administration) to the WGA Forest Health Advisory Committee.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 56
